text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My name is Biko Pegasus! Otherwise known 
as the hero of justice... Ta-dah! —Justice 
Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to become an Umamusume like 
Carrotman, bringing courage and hope to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If it's to become the hero I've always 
dreamed of being, I can work super hard! 
Let's do this, Trainer!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
